items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 7 Dec (UK only). Jamz is joined by Lenna Bahule, the Mozambican vocalist, composer and body percussionist whose music moves between Mozambique, Brazil and the wider Afro diaspora, often sung in African and imagined languages. Following her first UK tour this autumn, she speaks on her album KUMLANGO, which takes its name from the Jaua word for "portal", and Do Leste em Diante, her new live show built on research into transatlantic musical connections. Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music
items.title: with Lenna Bahule

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 23 Nov (UK only). Jamz is joined by Norsicaa, the Malaysian-Australian DJ and selector who ran Soundway Records for eight years before setting up her own label, Sama Sama Records. She speaks on the label’s focus on reissues and overlooked music from the Asia-Pacific... Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music
items.title: with Norsicaa

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 16 Nov (UK only). Jamz is joined on the show by British-Pakistani DJ and producer Ahadadream to talk about his debut album, featuring Skrillex, Priya Ragu, Capo Lee and Eliza Rose. Plus Dialled In, the South Asian arts and culture platform he co-founded, and the UK club scene that shaped him. Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 6 Music
